task_description: Look up a shipment by tracking number.
Truncate a long description to a maximum length.
Change the priority of a task, given its numeric id and the new priority.
Sort the product list by a caller-chosen column and direction.
Mark a list of messages as read.
Read a nickname saved at sign-up and list the forum posts signed with it.

Return the bookings of a room, optionally only for one day.
Show the orders for the customer name stored on a support ticket.
